Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.

args.goal: On the RFQ create screen, select the product CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB so Product Variant shows Default Variant, set Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), open Terms & Conditions, edit one clause, click Reset to Default, and stop only when the modal visibly shows the clause restored to the company-default value
